title: Nightscout URL should support tokens
symptom: xDrip supports Nightscout uploading and following using a URL of the form https://API_SECRET@my.nightscout.place/api/v1, where the username is used as the auth token. The API_SECRET is too secret and hard to revoke, so the user attempted to use a token as the username instead, but it was rejected by cgm-remote-monitor. The user requests that URLs support token access.
cause: The thread does not identify a single root cause. It suggests that Nightscout's cgm-remote-monitor rejected the token when used as a username in the URL, and that HTTP basic auth is not supported. Later, a user found that setting the environment variable AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES to "denied" allowed token-based access.
fix: The thread reports that setting the Nightscout environment variable AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES to "denied" allows token-based access. Additionally, a user confirmed that using a custom Access Token (created from the Admin Tools menu) before the @ symbol in the REST API URL works in xDrip+.
evidence_quote: Ha, found a solution by surprise: I have to set the env var AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES to "denied". I really went through the possible vars but just didn't recognize it. My bad.
